text:
alex chen: pd alert fired - SERVICE: inference-api-high-latency -> Sev2. PagerDuty escalation policy 3.

incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty incident 24567 created for service inference-api-high-latency.
incident-bot: Trigger: Response latency p99 > 2.5s for 3m.
incident-bot: Escalation stage 1: primary on-call notified.

alex chen: acked on PD, looking into tail latency spikes. seeing a small backlog on the autoscaler.

pagerduty-bot: Acknowledgement received from alex chen.
pagerduty-bot: If no mitigation within 8m, will escalate to secondary.

maya ramos: joining — any error traces? which backend pool?

alex chen: backend: dedicated-gpu-pool-3. logs show intermittent queuing at shard-7. attaching quick jstack snippet.
```
03:12:44 shard-7 queue depth: 42
03:12:45 kv-cache miss spike
03:12:46 kernel fallback to slower matmul
```

samir patel: I can take GPU-side. pulling metrics now (nv-smi + perf).

nina k.: any customer impact yet? support slack thread shows 2 customers with 500 errors.

alex chen: impact: degraded latency and token errors for longer sequences >1024. customer A and customer B reported higher error rates ~1.3%.

maya ramos: can we toggle model variant fallback to smaller quantized version as temporary mitigation?

samir patel: can do. I can push a routing override to route 30% traffic to model-quant-v2 for seq>1024. gives lower perf but avoids kernel fallback.

alex chen: do it. add slow-rollout canary 10% -> 30%. notify if any errors.

samir patel: pushing route override:
```
curl -X POST https://console.internal.api/routing/overrides \
  -d '{"service":"inference-api","match":"seq_len>1024","traffic_pct":10,"target":"model-quant-v2"}' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN"
```

incident-bot: Routing override applied (10%). Monitoring.

maya ramos: initial canary looks fine, latency down ~400ms for canary. errors dropped for those requests.

pagerduty-bot: Escalation timer expiring in 3m. No secondary ack yet.

alex chen: bumping to 30% now.

samir patel: updated to 30%.

nina k.: support confirms Customer A error rate back to baseline, Customer B still at 0.4% — may be cached failures.

pagerduty-bot: Escalation step 2 fired: secondary on-call (nina k.) notified.
pagerduty-bot: Secondary escalation: pager 5523 -> not acknowledged within 2m.

nina k.: acking now. sorry, was on a call. taking over for verification and postmortem notes.

oncall-manager: seeing PD note about missed ack earlier — please add "missed-ack" tag in incident writeup and summarize timeline for ops review.

alex chen: +1 will add. mitigation: routing fallback implemented, autoscaler tweak queued to increase max replicas temporarily, and a kernel fallback patch queued for next deploy.

maya ramos: long-term: need kernel selection guard to avoid fallback to slower path when queue depth spikes — filing ticket INF-1893.

nina k.: customer impact summary for CS:
- Window: 2026-11-03T03:12:00Z -> 2026-11-03T03:28:00Z
- Affected: customers A,B (partial errors), additional customers saw latency regressions
- Severity: Sev2 (service degradation with user-visible errors)
- Mitigation: routing fallback to model-quant-v2 (rolled 10% -> 30%), autoscaler limit increase, monitoring restored

pagerduty-bot: Incident 24567 updated: status acknowledged, responders: alex chen, samir patel, maya ramos, nina k.

alex chen: will keep thread open for final confirmation and postmortem notes. thanks all. :tada: 

nina k.: adding postmortem owner: alex chen. tagging oncall-manager for missed-ack review.
